title: Ironwood Ski Estate | KEY.co
description_expanded: The home’s state-of-the-art kitchen is a chef's dream, featuring marble countertops and top-of-the-line Wolf appliances. Meals can be enjoyed in the elegant dining area that comfortably seats eight, or at the cozy kitchen bar. The master suite is a sanctuary of luxury with a king bed, flat-screen TV, gas fireplace, and a private balcony, complemented by a master bath with a freestanding tub. Additional bedrooms offer king beds, HD Smart TVs, and private baths, ensuring comfort and privacy for all. The fourth bedroom, ideal for children, features twin-over-twin bunk beds and entertainment options. With high-end amenities and direct access to the pristine Deer Valley slopes, this home is the ultimate destination for a luxurious ski getaway. Nestled in the prestigious Ironwood community of Deer Valley's Empire Pass, this exquisite ski-in/ski-out property offers an unparalleled mountain retreat. Spanning 3,564 square feet, this recently remodeled haven combines luxurious comfort with unbeatable convenience, located just 35 feet from the slopes. The interior showcases a professionally designed layout, boasting contemporary furnishings from Restoration Hardware and a striking stone fireplace that soars from floor to ceiling in the living room. Whether you're unwinding by the fire or enjoying the latest games on the PlayStation in the lower-level family room, every detail is curated for relaxation and entertainment.
